title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — November 04, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.2 (Peaked November 04, 2026 at 06:54 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 422 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.33)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Little burst of solar energy! 🔥🌎

Today’s images show a broad dark coronal region and several bright active areas, while the coronagraph appears free of any obvious major outward structure.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
